part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) will continue to implement case-by-case reviews for certain high-performance chips exported to PRC companies, with a policy shift from a 'presumption of denial' to a more permissive stance for at least 5% of previously restricted transactions by 2027-08-09.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security
resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage of high-performance chip export license applications to PRC companies approved under case-by-case review that were previously under a presumption of denial

baseline.value: N/A (policy shift implemented Jan 13, 2026; specific approval rate not published)

part1_forecasts.statement: The AI OVERWATCH Act, or similar legislative measures, will lead to a formal ban on advanced chip sales to China, impacting at least 3 major U.S. chip manufacturers' ability to export to the PRC by 2028-02-08.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of major U.S. chip manufacturers with formal statutory bans on advanced chip sales to the PRC

baseline.value: 0 (AI OVERWATCH Act advanced Jan 21, 2026, but not enacted)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count of unique manufacturers subject to a statutory ban

part1_forecasts.statement: The United States will maintain its dominant position in global AI compute capacity, holding at least 70% of the market share by 2031-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage of global AI compute capacity controlled by the United States

part1_forecasts.statement: The 'GOLD EAGLE' initiative will lead to the successful identification and remediation of at least 100 significant software vulnerabilities impacting U.S. national security systems by 2027-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of significant software vulnerabilities identified and remediated

part1_forecasts.statement: The MATCH Act will result in a measurable decline in the import of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to Chinese fabrication facilities, with a 10% reduction in value reported by 2028-02-08.

resolution_criteria.metric: Year-over-year percentage decrease in the value of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment imported into China

baseline.value: N/A (MATCH Act introduced April 2, 2026; impact data not yet available)

part1_forecasts.statement: The Genesis Mission, expanded through federal commitments, will facilitate at least 5 significant AI-driven scientific discoveries in areas like drug development or materials science by 2029-08-09.

resolution_criteria.source: Office of Science and Technology Policy
resolution_criteria.metric: Number of significant AI-driven scientific discoveries

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. government will impose further export controls beyond those related to advanced chips, specifically targeting AI-related software and algorithms, impacting at least 2 new categories of export by 2028-02-08.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of new categories of AI-related software and algorithms subject to export controls

part1_forecasts.statement: China's domestic AI chip production capacity will see a stagnation or marginal decline in its growth rate due to U.S. regulations and equipment controls, with its share of global advanced chip production falling by at least 3 percentage points by 2030-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage point change in China's share of global advanced chip production

baseline.value: N/A (specific China production share data not provided in dossier)

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. federal government will increase its direct investment or grant funding for domestic AI semiconductor manufacturing by at least $10 billion by 2027-08-09, as part of its strategy to secure national dominance.

resolution_criteria.metric: Cumulative increase in federal investment or grant funding for domestic AI semiconductor manufacturing

baseline.value: N/A (specific total federal investment for AI semiconductors not published)

part1_forecasts.statement: International collaboration on AI security standards will be characterized by a U.S.-led bloc, with at least 5 allied nations signing onto U.S.-proposed frameworks for AI national security by 2029-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of allied nations signing onto U.S.-proposed AI national security frameworks
